objetivo_pt: Relatar o que alguém disse (reported speech) com afirmações e mudança de tempo verbal.

aquecimento.situacao_pt: O professor vai dizer frases e pedir que você as reporte: "You said that…" / "He said that…".
aquecimento.papel_professor: Diga frases e peça que o aluno reporte (I'm tired → You said you were tired). Ensine backshift: presente → passado, will → would, can → could. Corrija pronomes e tempos.
aquecimento.abertura: I'm very busy today. — Now, tell me: what did I say?
aquecimento.abertura_pt: Estou muito ocupado hoje. — Agora, me diga: o que eu disse?

vocabulario.exemplo_en: She said that she was tired.
He told me that he would be late.
vocabulario.exemplo_pt: Ele me disse que iria se atrasar.

vocabulario.exemplo_en: She mentioned that the price had changed.
vocabulario.exemplo_pt: Ela mencionou que o preço tinha mudado.

vocabulario.exemplo_en: He explained that the machine was old.
vocabulario.exemplo_pt: Ele explicou que a máquina era velha.

vocabulario.exemplo_en: The supplier claimed that they had sent the parts.
vocabulario.exemplo_pt: O fornecedor alegou que tinha enviado as peças.

vocabulario.exemplo_en: The client confirmed that they would come.
He admitted that he had made a mistake.
vocabulario.exemplo_pt: Ele admitiu que tinha cometido um erro.

vocabulario.exemplo_en: They complained that the delivery was late.
vocabulario.exemplo_pt: Reclamaram que a entrega estava atrasada.

vocabulario.en: the day before / the next day
vocabulario.pt: no dia anterior / no dia seguinte
vocabulario.exemplo_en: She said she had called the day before.
vocabulario.exemplo_pt: Ela disse que tinha ligado no dia anterior.

vocabulario.exemplo_en: He said he was working there then.
vocabulario.exemplo_pt: Ele disse que estava trabalhando lá naquele momento.

gramatica.explicacao_pt: Quando relatamos algo com verbo no passado (said, told), o tempo verbal geralmente 'volta um passo' (backshift): presente → passado ("I'm tired" → She said she was tired); present continuous → past continuous; present perfect / past → past perfect ("I've finished" → He said he had finished); will → would; can → could; must → had to. Pronomes, tempo e lugar também mudam: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before, here → there, this → that. SAY + (that) frase; TELL + PESSOA + (that) frase: He told me… (nunca 'He said me').

linhas: They said they would call me.
He said he had sent it.
She told me she could help.
He said he had seen him the day before.
saw → had seen; yesterday → the day before

exemplos.en: "The parts will arrive tomorrow." → The supplier said the parts would arrive the next day.
exemplos.pt: "As peças chegam amanhã." → O fornecedor disse que as peças chegariam no dia seguinte.

exemplos.en: "I'm working on it." → He told me he was working on it.
exemplos.pt: "Estou trabalhando nisso." → Ele me disse que estava trabalhando nisso.

exemplos.en: "We've never had this problem." → They claimed they had never had that problem.
exemplos.pt: "Nunca tivemos este problema." → Eles alegaram que nunca tinham tido aquele problema.

exemplos.en: "I made a mistake." → She admitted that she had made a mistake.
exemplos.pt: "Cometi um erro." → Ela admitiu que tinha cometido um erro.

falas.en: Did you call the steel supplier? What did they say?
falas.pt: Você ligou para o fornecedor de aço? O que disseram?

falas.en: I talked to Mr. Lopes. He said the truck had left the day before.
falas.pt: Falei com o Sr. Lopes. Ele disse que o caminhão tinha saído no dia anterior.

falas.en: He told me it would arrive on Thursday morning. He also mentioned that the price was going to increase next month.
falas.pt: Ele me disse que chegaria na quinta de manhã. Também mencionou que o preço ia aumentar no mês que vem.

falas.en: He said it would be about 8%. He explained that their energy costs had gone up.
falas.pt: Ele disse que seria uns 8%. Explicou que os custos de energia deles tinham subido.

perguntas.enunciado: By how much will the price increase?

opcoes: Their energy costs had gone up.

pratica.frase: "We will call you." → They said they ___ call me.
He ___ me that he would be late.

opcoes: He said me that he was busy.
He told me that he was busy.
He told that he was busy me.
pratica.explicacao_pt: TELL + pessoa; SAY sem pessoa (ou 'say to someone').

pratica.frase: He admitted that he had made a mistake
pratica.traducao_pt: Ele admitiu que tinha cometido um erro

pratica.audio: The client confirmed that they would come.

pratica.pt: Ela disse que tinha ligado no dia anterior.
respostas: She said she had called the day before.
She said that she had called the day before.

conversa.situacao_pt: O professor vai te contar o que três pessoas disseram numa reunião (frases diretas). Depois, relate para ele o que cada uma disse, como se ele não estivesse lá.
conversa.papel_professor: Diga 3 falas diretas de personagens (Ana: 'I can't come tomorrow.' Rui: 'We've finished the tests.' Bia: 'The client will visit us next week.'). Peça o relato. Corrija backshift e said/told.
conversa.abertura: Here's what happened in the meeting. Ana said: 'I can't come tomorrow.' Now you tell me what she said.
conversa.abertura_pt: Foi isto que aconteceu na reunião. Ana disse: "Não posso vir amanhã." Agora me diga o que ela disse.
